title: Freestanding paper towel holder 18-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base | Traditional Style | Allied Brass
description:
Add a refined, freestanding paper towel holder to keep countertops organized—crafted from solid brass with an 18-Inch height and a weighted base for stability. Designed in a traditional style that pairs well with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories while fitting beautifully into kitchen décor.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Weighted base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Overall size: 5.5-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
